run_preprocess_relaxed_cli: run the preprocess_relaxed CLI to extract graph features from trajectory files into LMDB databases for S2EF
run_write_images_to_lmdb: run write_images_to_lmdb to convert ASE trajectory files into pickled graph data objects stored in LMDB
run_main_preprocess: run main to chunk trajectory files across workers and spawn a multiprocessing pool for LMDB preprocessing
refactor_write_images_to_lmdb: refactor write_images_to_lmdb to support additional atom properties or different serialization formats beyond pickle
review_main_multiprocessing: review main to understand how AtomsToGraphs is initialized and how trajectory files are distributed across workers
